findings.summary: Visual Studio, compiler, SDK, and Ninja discovery remained embedded in the scene command while setup and doctor needed the same answers; the discovery now has one tested module shared by all three paths

preflight and build setup could each invoke Visual Studio discovery more than once in one command; resolved development and Windows tool sets are now cached for the invocation and invalidated after setup installs artifacts
an invalid explicit NINJA_PATH silently fell through to another Ninja even though explicit CMake, vcpkg, Tint, and DXC overrides fail by name; explicit Ninja selection now follows the same contract
validation input and output fingerprints could walk the same source or generated root repeatedly when several scenes shared a directory; roots are normalized and deduplicated before traversal
